items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including critical arbitrary code execution (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) and privilege escalation (CVE-2026-92909, CVSS 9.8) in Adobe Commerce B2B. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system writes, and security feature bypass.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (CVE-2026-75650) under active attack
items.summary: A zero-day template engine injection vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical flaw.

items.title: Magento Security Bulletins: CVEs & Fixed-In Versions (September 2026 bulletin)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover (APSB26-92)
items.summary: This update fixes seven vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1). Exploitation allows attackers to switch a customer session to another account, gaining access to private customer data.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (includes PolyShell)
items.summary: This update resolves critical vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6) known as PolyShell. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution.
